item.title: Commissioner Causey urges renters to get insurance after NC apartment fire
item.description: North Carolina Insurance Commissioner Mike Causey is urging renters across the state to review their insurance coverage following a large apartment fire in Morrisville that left several people injured and dozens displaced.

item.title: Duke Energy donates $10K to New Hanover County Community Justice Center
item.description: The New Hanover County Community Justice Center received a major donation from Duke Energy on Tuesday.

item.title: Carolina Beach to host cyber security workshop after $488K cyber attack
item.description: Carolina Beach officials shared an update on Tuesday during a council meeting after the town fell victim to two cyberattacks late last year.

item.title: NHCS approves second settlement in sex abuse lawsuit involving Michael Kelly
item.description: The New Hanover County Board of Education voted Tuesday to approve a settlement negotiated by the district’s insurer in the second civil lawsuit brought by survivors of abuse by former teacher Michael Kelly.

item.title: Naturalization ceremony recognizes 57 new U.S. citizens
item.description: A naturalization ceremony was held as part of the First in Freedom fest in honor of the United States’ 250th anniversary of independence.

item.title: Multi-agency training focuses on search and rescue operations in Pender County
item.description: The Pender County Sheriff's Office hosted a special search and rescue training on Tuesday.

item.title: An Act of Kindness from one woman to another
item.description: Dolores Fallon, and Portia, are co-workers at Brunswick Novant Medical Center. The pair built a bond after meeting at another co-worker's memorial service.

item.title: Cape Fear Community College announces expansion at Surf City Campus
item.description: Cape Fear Community College is celebrating a major expansion in Pender County.

item.title: Town of Shallotte board of aldermen approves zoning definitions for data centers
item.description: In Brunswick County, the town of Shallotte's Board of Aldermen took a proactive step regarding data centers by unanimously approving zoning definitions for them last month.

item.title: Forgotten NC Black Patriots of the Revolutionary War remembered during First in Freedom event
item.description: Jacob is one of the more than 460 North Carolinian African American men, both enslaved and free, who fought during the Revolutionary War.
